title: Tesla Roadster
why_read: A big HN discussion thread about Tesla's new Roadster reveal, interesting mainly as cultural/business commentary rather than deep technical content.
analysis: This is a discussion thread about the Tesla Roadster, a long-delayed electric sports car with flashy claimed performance figures. The engagement is huge but the topic is mostly product hype, pricing speculation, and skepticism about Musk's track record rather than engineering substance. For engineers interested in EV powertrain or battery technology there is little deep technical detail here, it reads more as general tech-industry news.
